name: CurriculumMapMatrix
tagline: Course × learning-outcome mapping with live coverage, gap and sequence analysis – for Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps.
description: Map every course to programme learning outcomes at Introduced, Developed or Mastered level (or your own scale), see coverage and mastery KPIs instantly and get accreditation-style gap reports: uncovered outcomes, missing mastery, unassessed mastery, out-of-sequence levels and unmapped or overloaded courses. Includes a progression view by year and touch-friendly phone cards.
features: Course × outcome matrix grouped by year and category
Alignment dialog with assessment method and evidence
Gap and sequence analysis with Show-in-matrix
Filters: search, year, category, gaps only, required only
Configurable level scale, rules, labels and colours
Phone card layout by course or outcome
15 outputs and a Power Pages change event
